note: storage-gc module not found at any known kit-relative location

target: pwd && rg --files -g '!*~' | sed -n '1,240p' && wc -l raw_memories.md MEMORY.md memory_summary.md phase2_workspace_diff.md 2>/dev/null || true && find extensions -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name instructions.md -print 2>/dev/null

printf '%s
' '--- headers ---'; rg -n '^# Task Group:|^## Task [0-9]|^### rollout_summary_files|^## User preferences|^## Reusable knowledge|^## Failures' MEMORY.md; printf '%s
' '--- ad-hoc notes ---'; for f in extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md; do echo "FILE $f"; sed -n '1,200p' "$f"; done; printf '%s
' '--- diff changed paths ---'; rg -n '^diff --git|^[-+]rollout_summary_file:|^[-+]description:|^[-+]updated_at:|^[-+]Preference signals:|^[-+]Reusable knowledge:|^[-+]Failures and how' phase2_workspace_diff.md

printf '%s
' '--- schema ---'; head -n 1 memory_summary.md; rg -n '^# Task Group:|^## Task [0-9]|^### rollout_summary_files|^### keywords' MEMORY.md; printf '%s
' '--- missing rollout references ---'; rg -o 'rollout_summaries/[^ )]+' MEMORY.md | sort -u | while read -r f; do test -f "$f" || printf 'MISSING %s
' "$f"; done; printf '%s
' '--- stale deleted refs ---'; rg -n -m 20 'routing_and_close_report_verification_gap|routing_and_incomplete_closeout|closure_partial_verification|deploy_project_filter_attachments' MEMORY.md || true; printf '%s
' '--- workspace diff ---'; git diff --stat && git diff --check && git status --short
head -n 6 MEMORY.md; tail -n 4 MEMORY.md; rg -n '^# Task Group:' MEMORY.md

printf '%s
' '--- handbook structure ---'; rg -n '^# Task Group:' MEMORY.md; printf '%s
' '--- reference audit ---'; rg -o 'rollout_summaries/[^ )]+' MEMORY.md | sort -u | while read -r f; do test -f "$f" || printf 'MISSING %s
' "$f"; done; printf '%s
' '--- task section audit ---'; awk 'BEGIN{bad=0} /^## Task [0-9]+:/{task=$0; rs=0; kw=0} /^### rollout_summary_files$/{rs=1} /^### keywords$/{kw=1} /^## (User preferences|Reusable knowledge|Failures)/{if(task!="" && (!rs || !kw)){print "BAD " task}; task=""} END{if(task!="" && (!rs || !kw)) print "BAD " task}' MEMORY.md; printf '%s
' '--- summary ---'; head -n 3 memory_summary.md; printf '%s
' '--- diff check ---'; git diff --check; git diff -- MEMORY.md memory_summary.md | sed -n '1,240p'
